name: Hodiah
overview: The name Hodiah appears in Scripture primarily in the book of Nehemiah, identifying individuals who played significant roles among the Levites and leaders of Israel. Hodijah is mentioned alongside other Levites who helped the people understand the law and led them in worship, highlighting a commitment to teaching and blessing the LORD. The references also indicate Hodiah as an Israelitish chief and a Levite, showing a position of spiritual and communal leadership during the post-exilic restoration period.
